input_corrections: Verified 27 October release, including 12,629 Brazilian historical matches
replay: Full available history, same input and engine for every candidate
selection_rule: Among candidates whose all-match selection log loss is no more than 0.001 above baseline, choose the lowest international selection log loss. Require at least 0.001 improvement over baseline; otherwise retain baseline. International means cross-border competitive continental, intercontinental, global or super-cup fixtures between different associations.
review_guard: After selection, retain baseline if the selected candidate worsens review-period all-match log loss by more than 0.005 or international log loss by more than 0.01. Do not select a runner-up using the review period.
disclosure: These periods have been inspected in previous releases. This is a finite retrospective comparison, not an untouched holdout or proof of unbiased global rankings. Named club rankings do not select the model. No further candidate search in this comparison.

fit.status: Structural corrections with dated Brazilian historical results
fit.selection: Predictive coefficients unchanged. Structural corrections preserve strength on division changes and country recentering. Dated Brazilian national, Paulista and Carioca results extend historical coverage. Retrospective paired comparisons accompany the release.
